name: indahl-batch
description: Run a check or audit over something too big for one context window, such as a whole site, a large repo or a folder of papers. Splits the job into batches with fresh workers, writes results to files and merges them with nothing dropped. Runs inside your session.

defaultPrompt: Audit every page of this site in batches.
